scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/onlycells build && bun run --cwd apps/demo ./build.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/onlycells typecheck && tsc -p apps/demo/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/onlycells build:vendor && bun test ./packages/onlycells/test ./apps/demo/test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun test ./packages/onlycells/test ./apps/demo/test
scripts.security:check: bun run check && bun run build
